name: Orderfacts.linecount equals completed non-proposal order lines in range, tenant-scoped
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-09-01'
